diagnosis.root_cause: Elevated latency in payments-api caused transactions to hold database connections open longer in checkout-api, which exhausted the checkout-api database connection pool (size=20, active=20, waiters=140) and worker thread pool, resulting in HTTP 503 errors.
evidence: checkout-api error rate metric spiked to ~0.34 starting around 09:22 UTC
checkout-api db_pool_wait_ms metric increased from ~2ms to over 5000ms starting at 09:20 UTC
checkout-api log: DB connection pool exhausted (size=20, active=20, waiters=140) at 2026-06-03T09:21:00Z
checkout-api log: worker thread pool exhausted; rejecting inbound requests at 2026-06-03T09:22:00Z
payments-api p95_latency_ms metric spiked from ~90ms to over 400ms starting at 09:16 UTC
diagnosis.recommended_fix: Mitigate the payments-api performance degradation to reduce transaction duration, increase the database connection pool and worker thread pool limits on checkout-api as an immediate relief measure, and follow up by implementing query timeout protection and circuit breakers between checkout-api and payments-api.
